title: kane-qe
See every kane-cli test, right inside Claude Code
end: A Claude Code plugin for kane-cli

segments.caption: Always above the prompt
segments.sub: What kane-cli is doing, your last run, and how much of your requirements is proven.

segments.caption: Ask Claude to test
segments.sub: The run shows up in the chat as it happens: the test, its time, the step it is on.

segments.caption: Watch it live
segments.sub: The band follows the same step, and the mascot's eyes move while kane-cli works.

segments.caption: Every run leaves a card
segments.sub: Pass or fail, kane-cli's own reason for a failure, and how sure it is.

segments.caption: One click to the steps
segments.sub: What the agent thought, did and checked, with kane-cli's verdict on top.

segments.caption: One click to the evidence
segments.sub: View evidence opens that run's evidence pack in your browser.

segments.caption: Claude changes your code
segments.sub: The band notices at once: 1 file changed, untested.

segments.caption: Test this change
segments.sub: It offers the saved tests that cover the change, with their last result.

segments.caption: Proven
segments.sub: The saved test runs, the card is green, and the warning clears.

segments.caption: Or let Claude test by itself
segments.sub: In auto mode Claude is held at the end of its turn until the change is tested.

segments.caption: Claude runs the test
segments.sub: No button, no prompt: it picks the saved test and runs it.

segments.caption: And reports back
segments.sub: Another green card in the conversation.

segments.caption: Whole suites at a glance
segments.sub: One cell per test, how many are done, and what is running now.

segments.caption: One card for the suite
segments.sub: Its counts, a cell per test, and the suite's evidence.

segments.caption: Runs started anywhere
segments.sub: Tests started in another terminal show up too, by name, with no setup.

segments.caption: Requirement coverage
segments.sub: How much is designed, how much is proven, and what each use case still owes.

segments.caption: Open a use case
segments.sub: Every gap, kane-cli's next command for it, and one button to hand it to Claude.

segments.caption: History
segments.sub: Every finished run in this project: when, how long, and where it failed.
